note: Kit-autonomy gauntlet 2026-08-02: test-first faithfulness model authored from blablalink prose (data/characters.json → characters.kurumi.skills). Kurumi (AR/Supporter/Iron, Burst I, cd 20s) is a Hacked-DoT applier + team damage-taken debuffer. S1 'Malicious Code Injection' has TWO triggers, both inflicting the same Hacked DoT (52.24% of final ATK as sustained damage every 1s for 5s = 5 ticks): (A) after landing 36 normal attacks on the target (hitCount:36), and (B) on burst cast to all enemies (burstCast — NOT fullBurstEnter: kurumi is Burst I, so this keys to rotations SHE wins the B1 slot; a fullBurstEnter model would over-credit on rotations a different B1 casts). Each application opens a 5s 'Hacked' status window (targetStatus) AND spawns an independent 5-tick sustained DoT instance (the DoT ticks are crit-eligible at the caster rate per the engine DOT_CRIT default; the kit does not exempt them). S2 'Payload Diffusion' is an 86.17%-of-final-ATK additional-damage rider (flatDamage, crit-eligible by the rider convention, never cores) gated THREE ways: a 36-normal-attack counter (hitCount:36, its own counter independent of S1's), the Full Burst window (fbGate inFb — 'during Full Burst'), and the Hacked status (requiresTargetStatus 'Hacked'). Block order is load-bearing: S1-A precedes S2 in the block array, so on a 36th hit that lands in FB the Hacked status is written earlier the same frame and S2 reads it open (the d-killer-wife same-frame pattern). Burst 'Defense Protocol Breakdown' is a pure debuff — Damage Taken ▲18.06% on all enemies for 10s (damageTakenPct on the enemy → the engine's taken multiplier amplifies ALL damage dealt to the boss while active; the buffApply emits casterIdx/targetIdx null, filter by stat+value); it deals NO damage. The 'all enemies' scope collapses to the single boss entity (targetStatus/damageTakenPct are implicitly enemy-targeted; the validator requires target enemy). Cross-family S2b (claude-fable-5) converged: all four lines FAITHFUL + load-bearing. Residual ⚑s (measurement-gated, engine-native defaults shipped, none block GO): (1) S2's exact proc COUNT is timing-sensitive (a 36-hit multiple must land inside a FB window while Hacked is up) and is not footage-pinned — the magnitude (86.17), the FB-gating, and the status-gate encoding are faithful to prose; the requiresTargetStatus gate is behaviorally near-redundant with the burstCast-Hacked coverage during FB in the control fixture (Hacked is up almost every FB), so its discrimination is masked there — a fixture/measurement limitation, not an encoding gap. (2) DoT re-application STACKING: S1-A re-fires every 36 rounds (~3s of AR fire) with a 5s duration, so the engine appends OVERLAPPING independent DoT instances; whether in-game Hacked REFRESHES (one live instance) or STACKS (multiplying) is kit-silent — the engine-native independent-instance reading is shipped; pin from footage when a Hacked popup-read is available. (3) S2's 36-hit counter is now countScope:'gated' (2026-08-16 triage): the kit reads 'during Full Burst after landing 36 normal attack(s)', scoping the COUNTING to FB — the counter accrues only in-FB hits and resets per FB window. The FB+Hacked gates are checked at fire time (fbGate + requiresTargetStatus). Prior reading was cumulative-with-gate (counter accrued always, gates checked at fire time); the prose ambiguity is now resolved in favor of the gated reading.
